answer: One concrete Sybil defense is staked identity with slashing. Each agent must lock a copper bond in an oasis pool, and a relic attestation ties that identity to a single hardware root of trust. To mint N fake agents, an attacker needs N distinct bonds and N passing uniqueness checks; duplicates found later get every bond slashed. The cost rises linearly with each clone while rewards are divided, so mass impersonation burns more capital than it can earn.
